description: This Go source file defines functions for denormalizing data related to project diffs, commits, and targets within the repository. It interacts with repositories to retrieve and process the most recent differential and commit information, and performs various denormalization tasks such as generating views of recent projects, commits, and top contributors.

methods.name: DenormalizeData
methods.description: Main entry point to trigger denormalization of recent projects, diffs, and commits based on the provided application configuration.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentProject
methods.description: Iterates over diff targets from the config and denormalizes each to its most recent view.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentProjectForTarget
methods.description: Processes a single diff target to denormalize its most recent project differential view.

methods.name: denormalizeDiffRows
methods.description: Iterates over diff targets from the config to denormalize their differential rows.

methods.name: denormalizeDiffRowsForTarget
methods.description: Processes a single diff target to denormalize its differential rows over time.

methods.name: getMappedTarget
methods.description: Converts a DiffTarget into a MappedDiffTarget using the source repository.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentCommit
methods.description: Denormalizes recent commit data for each diff target and updates global commit views.

methods.name: denormalizeViewRecentCommitGlobal
methods.description: Denormalizes top committer and top tech area globally.

methods.name: denormalizeCommitRows
methods.description: Processes commit rows for a target, fetching the most recent commits and their first seen timestamps, then denormalizing this data.

methods.name: extractCommitHashes
methods.description: Utility to extract commit hashes from commit row data.
